[[File:Proprietor.png|thumb|250px|The Proprietor]]
The '''Proprietor''' (Japanese: '''マスター''' ''Master''; real name unknown) is a recurring character in {{aniseries|DP}}.
==History==
He currently works as a server at a [[Sunyshore City]] café. However, a flashback revealed that he was once a [[Pokémon hunter|Pokémon poacher]], though he renounced this line of work after having a {{pkmn|battle}} against [[Volkner]] and [[Flint]] when they were kids, after which he befriended them.

The Proprietor, like Flint, had become frustrated with Volkner's lacking motivation and refusal to return to his role as the Sunyshore [[Gym Leader]]. After spotting a spark in Volkner in ''[[DP165|Flint Sparks the Fire!]]'', he instructed Flint to battle {{Ash}} and forced Volkner to watch. The ploy worked, as Volkner regained his interest in battling and agreed to go up against Ash.

In ''[[DP166|The Fleeing Tower of Sunyshore!]]'', the Proprietor returned to his café while Ash and Volkner had their [[Gym]] battle, though it soon lost power after {{TRT}} stole the [[Sunyshore Tower]]. He and several other electrical engineers helped restore Sunyshore City's main generator and power supply.

==Character==
The Proprietor is a mysterious individual with a secretive past as a [[Pokémon hunter|Pokémon poacher]]. Nowadays, he is a highly respected member of the {{ci|Sunyshore}} community. Both [[Volkner]] and [[Flint]] consult him for advice, and he willingly offers his opinion.
